documents_expiry_idx.name: documents_expiry_idx
documents_expiry_idx.where: "documents"."expires_on" is not null and "documents"."deleted_at" is null

appointments_cost_check.name: appointments_cost_check
appointments_cost_check.value: ("appointments"."cost_minor" is null) = ("appointments"."currency" is null) and ("appointments"."cost_minor" is null or "appointments"."cost_minor" >= 0)

medical_records_typed_check.name: medical_records_typed_check
medical_records_typed_check.value:
("medical_records"."next_due_on" is null or "medical_records"."type" = 'vaccination')
        and ("medical_records"."severity" is null or "medical_records"."type" in ('illness', 'injury', 'allergy'))
        and ("medical_records"."ended_on" is null or "medical_records"."type" not in ('vaccination', 'surgery'))

reminders_due_idx.name: reminders_due_idx
reminders_due_idx.where: "reminders"."done_at" is null and "reminders"."cancelled_at" is null and "reminders"."expired_at" is null

medication_schedules_interval_check.name: medication_schedules_interval_check
medication_schedules_interval_check.value:
("medication_schedules"."kind" = 'every_n_days') = ("medication_schedules"."interval_days" is not null)
        and ("medication_schedules"."interval_days" is null or "medication_schedules"."interval_days" between 2 and 365)
